source.caption: Mini guide to Bergen 🇳🇴 If you’re heading to Bergen, here are some spots you can't miss: - Go for a hike: reach new heights on the trails of Fløyen or challenge yourself on Løvstakken to enjoy spectacular panoramas of the surrounding fjords. -Walk around the neighbourhoods: lose yourself in the streets of Sandviken and Nordnes to discover the authentic charm of the city's iconic white wooden houses. -Watch the sunset: head up to the Fløyen viewpoints or find a spot by the water at Nordnes Park to watch the sky catch fire. -Try the local food: an unforgettable culinary experience, whether it's fresh local finds at Kaigaten Deli or exceptional seafood at Cornelius. -Cultural visits: step back in time among the leaning wooden warehouses of Bryggen, a UNESCO World Heritage site that tells the story of Bergen's ancient trading history. -Take a break: whether you want a chill spot, a cosy place or just a great cup of coffee (or chocolate!) Bergen’s cafés have you covered! 💙 Would you visit Bergen ? Save this guide for your next visit to Bergen! #bergen #visitnorway #visitbergen #norwaytrip #fjords

evidence.transcript: When you understand that the lat pulldown goes to the chin and not the chest, the lats will come. When you understand that the elbows and the biceps are not behind but a little bit forward, the biceps will grow. When you understand that the rope tricep extensions don't go to the body but to the floor, the triceps will come. When you understand that for the lateral raise, you don't have to go all the way up here but to shoulder height, the shoulders will pop. When you understand that your seated cable row doesn't go to your chest but to your waist, the lats will come. And most importantly, when you follow me, your muscles will grow.

entities.name: Lat pulldown
entities.hook: Pull the bar to chin level rather than all the way to the chest to better target the lats.

entities.name: Biceps curl
entities.hook: Keep the elbows slightly forward rather than behind the body to emphasize the biceps.

entities.name: Rope triceps extension
entities.hook: Extend the rope down toward the floor rather than directing it toward the body.

entities.name: Dumbbell lateral raise

entities.name: Seated cable row
